note: Every Donate button opens the organisation's own official page. FloodAssist Assam never collects or routes money. Confirm the account on that site before you pay.

channels.name: Chief Minister's Relief Fund, Assam
channels.summary: Official state relief fund used for flood aid and rehabilitation in Assam. 80G tax exemption available.
channels.howTo: Pay via SBI Collect, UPI (cmrfassam@sbi), or bank transfer using the details below.

account.name: Chief Minister's Relief Fund Assam
account.bank: State Bank of India, Secretariat Branch

channels.name: National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF)
channels.organization: Ministry of Home Affairs · Government of India
channels.summary: Central government disaster fund via BharatKosh. CarryMinati's Assam flood charity stream directed viewers here.
channels.howTo: Open BharatKosh → Quick Payment → Ministry: Home Affairs → Purpose: Contributions/Grants to NDRF.

account.name: Contributions / Grants to NDRF
account.bank: State Bank of India, Central Secretariat Branch, New Delhi

channels.name: PM CARES Fund
channels.organization: Prime Minister's Office, Government of India
channels.summary: National emergency relief fund. Accepts domestic and foreign donations with 80G exemption.

account.name: PM CARES
account.bank: State Bank of India, New Delhi Main Branch

channels.name: Bondhu Streams — Assam Flood Relief
channels.organization: Bondhu Streams × Dhiman Streams × Daden Group
channels.summary: Creator-led Assam flood fundraiser with a public live donation ledger. Not a government fund — verify details on their page before donating.
channels.howTo: Open their transparency page and use Donate for Assam. The live ledger lists verified contributions.

channels.name: Goonj — Rahat Floods
channels.summary: Long-running NGO delivering essential relief material to families in Assam and other flood-hit states.

channels.name: SEEDS India — Flood Response
channels.summary: Emergency kits and transitional shelters in Assam districts including Jorhat and Cachar.

channels.name: Rapid Response — Assam Floods
channels.summary: Disaster relief NGO active in Assam since 2016 — food packets, dry ration, hygiene kits, medical camps.

channels.name: Assam Foundation of North America
channels.summary: Volunteer foundation channeling international donations through FCRA partners for Upper Assam supplies.

inKindNote: Donating supplies (dry ration, hygiene kits, tarpaulin, etc.) is coordinated by ASDMA. Call toll-free 1077 before sending anything — unsolicited perishables slow relief.
